title: Tyler, TX — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Tyler, TX: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Tyler is a city in TX with a population of 105,000. Rose Capital of America with the Tyler Rose Garden and a growing healthcare sector. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 8b growing zone supports Warm — citrus, avocados, tomatoes, peppers.
